explication: Web Access is an Agent skill for choosing web-retrieval strategies and operating the user’s logged-in browser. The main flow is an Agent receiving a web task, applying the skill’s guidance, then using search/fetch tools or the CDP proxy to inspect and interact with pages; local browser history and saved site patterns support discovery and reuse. The graph includes the sampled runtime scripts and README-documented capabilities. Some strategy and integration details are documented but not shown in source excerpts, so those links are cited to the README.
